data_output.description: data.py must load the existing CSVs and preserve their original row order. It must retain user_id and video_id and add exactly tab, hourmin, and weekday as categorical fields derived from each impression timestamp/request context. encode(splits) must fit vocabularies on the training split only, map unseen validation/test values to per-field unknown buckets, return encoded[name] as (features, labels, users), and return the total flattened feature dimension. Validation features must remain in canonical evaluator row order, with no labels or ground-truth data written to predictions_valid.npz.

model_input.description: model.py must accept feature matrices shaped (n_rows, 5), with columns ordered user_id, video_id, tab, hourmin, weekday and flattened nonnegative integer indices. The factorization machine must score all supplied fields using the existing linear terms and pairwise embeddings, retain interaction_dimension=16, pointwise BCE gradients, Adam-style updates, learning rate, L2 regularization, state checkpointing, and prediction as a finite one-dimensional score array. train.py must emit predictions_valid.npz containing exactly row_ids and scores; row_ids must be np.arange(n_valid) and scores must correspond to the canonical validation feature order. Ground truth may be used only internally by the fixed evaluator, not by the artifact producer.
